drivers.p: Brent is down 11.2% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 93.92 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
